details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:1030-1046 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `gh_review_pr_state` calls `gh_retry gh_read --same-repo-only api "repos/${repo}/pulls/${number}" --jq .state 2>/dev/null` discard stderr, so the `GH_READ_FALLBACK reason=<code> caller=<script>` line never reaches the job log. Its callers include scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:4656, which also suppresses stderr per openai_gpt-6-luna. gh_retry's replay at scripts/gh_helpers.sh:2454/2456 cannot recover a line the caller has already discarded.
  WHY: A 401/403 sets the per-job latch, so the job switches to GH_PAT with no log line. This contradicts the contractual-prefix text ("a missing `permissions:` scope logs once per job"), and the E2E check "no GH_READ_FALLBACK is caused by a missing permission" can never fail here. Severity disagreement: MAJOR from anthropic, minimax and glm; NIT from luna; gemini gave none. The highest was used.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_queue.sh:251-289 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The wait-loop reads `gh_retry gh_read --same-repo-only api --method GET --paginate --slurp "repos/${SELF_REPO}/issues/${QUEUE_ISSUE}/comments?per_page=100" > "${COMMENTS_FILE}" 2>/dev/null` and `... > "${HOLDER_RUN_FILE}" 2>/dev/null` drop the GH_READ_FALLBACK line on every poll tick.
  WHY: In the heal intake and recovery-scan jobs, a token refusal latches and the job falls back to the PAT silently, so log analysis cannot detect the missing scope. Severity disagreement: MAJOR from anthropic, minimax and glm; NIT from luna; gemini gave none. The highest was used.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:142-149 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `actions: read`, `pull-requests: read` and `issues: read` are added to the workflow-level `permissions:` block, so every job without its own override gets them. Only validate (5580), release (5719) and sync-to-main (6480) override it, which leaves non-polling jobs such as source, resolve-version, validate-scripts and notify with scopes they do not use.
  WHY: This breaks least privilege and the issue's "per job" scope approach. anthropic and glm note the exposure is small because the scopes are read-only and `contents: write` was already workflow-wide. Severity disagreement: MAJOR from minimax and luna; NIT from anthropic and glm; gemini gave none. The highest was used.
- .github/workflows/promote-main-to-stable.yml:150 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The kill-switch expression `${{ vars.GH_READ_TOKEN_ENABLED != 'false' && github.token || '' }}` disables the token only for the literal `false`. The same expression appears in test-and-mark-stable.yml, review_autofix.yml:3527/3642/3983 and workflow-failure-heal-intake.yml. `GH_READ_TOKEN_ENABLED` is never exported, so the helper's `false|0|no|off` case never applies.
  WHY: Setting the repo variable to `0`, `no` or `off`, all documented disable values, leaves `github.token` exported and the feature on. Severity disagreement: MAJOR from minimax; NIT from luna and glm; gemini gave none. The highest was used.
- agents.d/9888-gh-read-token-polling.md:2 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The documented kill-switch contract ("false/0/no/off", also in the README.md `GH_READ_TOKEN_ENABLED` row) does not match the workflow expression `!= 'false'`.
  WHY: Operators who follow the docs and set `0`/`no`/`off` do not disable the feature, so documented behaviour differs from runtime behaviour. Severity disagreement: MAJOR from minimax; luna's combined finding was NIT. The highest was used.
- scripts/stable_e2e_step_wait_review.sh:229 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `GH_API_SAFE_USE_READ_TOKEN="${GH_API_SAFE_USE_READ_TOKEN:-1}"` opts every read into the job token, but every call targets `TEST_REPO`. The cross-repo check in `_gh_api_safe_job_token_read_run` (scripts/comprehensive_test_and_release_gh_api.sh:258-261) returns 3, so the job token is never used.
  WHY: The wait-review loop still spends GH_PAT budget and adds a wasted job-token attempt per read. MAJOR from minimax; gemini gave no severity. Disagreement: anthropic rejected this because TEST_REPO defaults to `${{ inputs.test_repo || github.repository }}` (test-and-mark-stable.yml line 603).
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:1262-1285 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `_gh_read_run` writes the latch only for 401/403. A `rate_limit` (or 404) result neither latches nor records a reset time.
  WHY: Once the shared GITHUB_TOKEN budget of 1,000 calls per hour is spent, every poll tick makes a failing job-token call plus a PAT call and logs one GH_READ_FALLBACK line until the window resets. That is extra latency and log noise, not a correctness failure. NIT from anthropic, minimax and glm; gemini gave none.
- scripts/comprehensive_test_and_release_gh_api.sh:297-317 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The twin `_gh_api_safe_job_token_read_run` latches only when `[ "${reason}" = "401" ] || [ "${reason}" = "403" ]`, so rate_limit is retried on every poll. minimax also notes that the cross-repo branch returns 3 without logging.
  WHY: This duplicates the round-trips and log noise of the gh_helpers.sh latch gap during long poll loops, while PAT answers stay correct. NIT from all three reviewers.
- scripts/comprehensive_test_and_release_gh_api.sh:118-122 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: In the gh_api_safe opt-in block (`if output="$(gh_api_safe_job_token_read "$@")"; then GH_API_SAFE_OUTPUT="${output}"; return 0; fi`), a job-token success returns without resetting RATE_LIMIT_BACKOFF. The PAT path does reset it (line 127).
  WHY: After one PAT rate-limit backoff, later PAT rate limits start at 60 s and then 120 s instead of 30 s, which lengthens the wait loop against its deadline. gemini, minimax and glm also listed this as hardening only.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Known polling loops ... scripts/validate_process.sh:5039, scripts/validate_driver.sh:703" / "The listed polling loops make their reads with GITHUB_TOKEN"
  expected_change_site: scripts/validate_process.sh (poll near line 5039), scripts/validate_driver.sh (poll near line 703), and the validate workflows that export GH_READ_TOKEN
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The PR changes neither script nor any validate workflow, neither file contains a gh_read or gh_api_safe_quiet_print_read call, neither is in pr_changed_files.txt or the plan grant's files_touched, tests/test_gh_read.py has no call-site assertion for them, and the issue does not defer them. Both reviewers rated this BLOCKER. anthropic and glm rejected the gap: line 5039 is `sleep "${POLL_INTERVAL}"` in a local loop with no GitHub call, and validate_driver.sh:703 is a docker health-poll sleep.
- requirement: "Add the GH_READ_TOKEN env and the read scopes per job" / "permissions: must already include read access to what the loop reads" / E2E: "no GH_READ_FALLBACK is caused by a missing permission"
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml, codex-agent job (around line 2008), `permissions:` block with `pull-requests: read` (and `actions: read`)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: review_autofix.yml has no `permissions:` block in the diff, and the PR adds only the GH_READ_TOKEN env lines (review_autofix.yml:3527, 3642, 3983). review_autofix_sweep.yml:99-102 declares `pull-requests: read`. The `gh_review_pr_state` reads from review_run_reviewers.sh:4656 and review_apply_fixes.sh:2294 would get 403, latch and fall back to the PAT. gemini rated this MAJOR and minimax BLOCKER. anthropic and glm rejected it: the workflow is reusable and its callers internal-review.yml:33-36 and workflow-templates/ai-review.yml:52 grant `pull-requests: write`.
- requirement: "tests/test_workflow_file_size_limit.py and tests/test_ci_wires_every_test_file.py pass."
  expected_change_site: the PR's validation result for tests/test_workflow_file_size_limit.py (validation of changed workflow files)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The PR acceptance table marks tests/test_workflow_file_size_limit.py as unmet (an inherited `baseline_timeout`), and the pre-push test gate is unverified. gemini rated this MAJOR and luna NIT. anthropic left it unconfirmed: the diff adds only about 250 bytes to review_autofix.yml.
- requirement: "scripts/stable_e2e_step_wait_review.sh:343,583,922,959 (POLL_INTERVAL)" should make reads with GITHUB_TOKEN
  expected_change_site: scripts/stable_e2e_step_wait_review.sh (gate the job-token path to same-repo reads, or add a same-repo gate to the gh_api_safe job-token branch)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: line 229 sets GH_API_SAFE_USE_READ_TOKEN=1, every call targets TEST_REPO (cross-repo), and `_gh_api_safe_job_token_read_run` returns 3, so the polling reads still use GH_PAT (rated MAJOR)
- requirement: "the read scopes per job" (restrict the new read scopes to the polling jobs rather than applying them workflow-wide)
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml job-level `permissions:` blocks on the polling jobs
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: the read scopes are in the workflow-level block (test-and-mark-stable.yml:142-149), and no job-level overrides were added (rated MAJOR)
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:1030,1046 (gh_review_pr_state); scripts/workflow_failure_heal_queue.sh:251,289 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `2>/dev/null` at these call sites throws away the `GH_READ_FALLBACK reason=<code> caller=<script>` line that gh_retry passes on (line 2456). After a 401/403, the latch makes every later gh_read run plain `gh "$@"` without logging anything.
  WHY: A token refusal moves the whole job back to GH_PAT with no GH_READ_FALLBACK line, which contradicts agents.d/9888-gh-read-token-polling.md ("a missing `permissions:` scope logs once per job"). The E2E check therefore cannot fail. Suggested fix: `2> >(grep -a '^GH_READ_FALLBACK ' >&2 || true)`.
- scripts/comprehensive_test_and_release_gh_api.sh:118-122 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: A job-token success in gh_api_safe returns without resetting RATE_LIMIT_BACKOFF. The PAT success path at line 127 does reset it.
  WHY: In stable_e2e_step_wait_review.sh, later PAT rate limits start at 60 s and then 120 s instead of 30 s, which lengthens the wait loop. Fix: `RATE_LIMIT_BACKOFF=0` before `return 0`.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh (_gh_read_run) and scripts/comprehensive_test_and_release_gh_api.sh (_gh_api_safe_job_token_read_run) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The latch is written only for 401/403. reason=rate_limit neither latches nor records a reset time.
  WHY: Once the 1,000/hr budget is spent, each poll tick doubles its round-trips and logs one fallback line per read for up to an hour. The issue accepts this risk, so the finding is advisory.
